_comment: DEEP-1B (96d L2, big-ann-benchmarks). Anchored on (recall, build_speed) at 1B scale: pq_chunks=48 (2d/chunk) keeps PQ noise small enough for 1B graph navigation; pruned_degree=96 / max_degree=128 (vs 64/96 for 10M) — 1B graphs need denser neighbourhoods to keep recall after the larger search radius; l_build=200 matches DiskANN paper Table 2 for billion-scale. num_threads=32 and build_ram_limit_gb=192 are the 'CPU/RAM are plenty' tier — 192 GB keeps PQ training in one pass for 360 GB raw data without sharding. metric MUST be L2 to match the official big-ann GT. Build wall-clock is still 1-2 days; this minimises it, not removes it.
